title: 第3章 狗屁神医废物一个第4章 回天十三针
slug: 狂仙出狱第2234章龙主燃尽
content_zh:
半小时后，宝路医院。
作为花城最好的一家私立医院，这里有着非常顶尖的医疗设施以及最好的医生。
当然，费用方面自然也是非常昂贵的了。
“每天各种费用加起来差不多快一万了，简直和抢钱差不多，最主要的是他们还治不好。”
“前些天请来一位号称‘江南圣手’的神医崔富，我和妈砸锅卖铁，又到处借，好不容易凑了十万。”
“那个崔神医给爸开了点药，信誓旦旦说一定能治好爸的病，结果昨天病情忽然恶化，连病危通知书都下了……”
陈怡说着，眼泪止不住的流，气的拳头紧握。
显然她对这家医院的水平是表示质疑的，尤其对这位所谓的崔神医，觉得对方就是个骗子！
可惜，她找不到证据，而且宝路医院很有背景，一般人也得罪不起。
“我知道了，放心吧，既然我回来了，爸不会有事的。”
陈凡拍了拍妹妹的肩膀，安慰道。
陈怡也不知道哥哥到底有什么办法，但这一刻，心中就是一种莫名的信任。
或许是之前在夜市上陈凡的表现太过震撼了，三年不见，陈怡觉得哥哥像是变了一个人一样。
“哥，你刚才说在监狱里，帮着抓通缉犯，治病救人都是真的？”
陈怡好奇地问道。
“当然是真的，你等会儿就什么都明白了。”
陈凡淡定地说道。
虽然父亲被下了病危通知，但只要人还在，他就有十足的信心治好！
兄妹二人一边说着，一边已经坐电梯来到了五楼的病房。
看着躺在床上奄奄一息的父亲陈和平，以及守在一旁以泪洗面的母亲范爱琴，陈凡的心像是被刀割一般。

还不到退休年龄的父母，已经是满头白发，分别三年的时间，仿佛对于他们而言像是过了三十年之久。
曾经幸福的家庭因为陈凡的锒铛入狱，彻底坠入了深渊！
陈凡心中无比自责，如果三年前可以冷静一点儿，只是将妹妹救走的话，所有的悲剧或许就不会发生了。
“当一个人没有足够的实力时，遇到事一定要选择冷静，只有当自己实力强大时，需要冷静的才是别人！”
这是陈凡在狱中悟出的真理。
所幸，现在一切都还不算晚，
陈凡还有机会弥补家人这些年受到的伤害。
“爸，妈，我回来了。”
陈凡推开病房的大门，红着眼说道。
“小凡！”
累趴在病床边上的母亲范爱琴猛的站了起来，顿时感到一阵眩晕。
content_en:
Half an hour later, Baolu Hospital.
As the best private hospital in Huacheng, it has very top medical facilities and the best doctors.
Of course, the cost is naturally very expensive.
"The daily expenses add up to almost 10,000 yuan. It's almost like robbing money. The most important thing is that they can't cure it."
"A few days ago, we invited Cui Fu, a miraculous doctor known as the 'Jiangnan Holy Hand'. My mother and I sold the pot and borrowed it from everywhere, and finally raised 100,000."
"That Dr. Cui gave Dad some medicine and swore that it would cure Dad's illness. However, yesterday his condition suddenly worsened and he even issued a critical illness notice..."
As Chen Yi spoke, her tears couldn't stop flowing and her fists clenched in anger.
Obviously she had doubts about the quality of this hospital, especially the so-called Dr. Cui, whom she felt was a liar!
It's a pity that she can't find any evidence, and Baolu Hospital has a good background, and ordinary people can't afford to offend it.
"I understand, don't worry, now that I'm back, dad will be fine."
Chen Fan patted his sister on the shoulder and comforted her.
Chen Yi didn't know what his brother could do, but at this moment, there was an inexplicable trust in his heart.
Perhaps it was because Chen Fan's performance at the night market was too shocking. After not seeing him for three years, Chen Yi felt that his brother seemed to be a different person.
"Brother, what you said just now is that you were in prison, helping to catch wanted criminals, and treating illnesses and saving people. Is this true?"
Chen Yi asked curiously.
"Of course it's true. You'll understand everything later."
Chen Fan said calmly.
Although his father was notified that he was critically ill, as long as he was still alive, he had full confidence that he would be cured!
As the brother and sister talked, they took the elevator to the ward on the fifth floor.
Seeing his father Chen Heping lying dying on the bed, and his mother Fan Aiqin standing by and crying, Chen Fan's heart felt as if it had been cut by a knife.
My parents, who have not yet reached retirement age, are already covered with gray hair. The three years since they were separated seems like thirty years to them.
The once happy family fell into a deep abyss because of Chen Fan's imprisonment!
Chen Fan felt extremely guilty. If he could have calmed down three years ago and just rescued his sister, all the tragedies might not have happened.
"When a person does not have enough strength, he must choose to be calm when encountering problems. Only when he is strong, others need to be calm!"
This is the truth that Chen Fan realized in prison.
Fortunately, it's not too late now.
Chen Fan still has a chance to make up for the harm his family has suffered over the years.
"Dad, Mom, I'm back."
Chen Fan pushed open the door to the ward and said with red eyes.
"Xiaofan!"
Her mother, Fan Aiqin, who was lying tiredly beside the hospital bed, suddenly stood up and felt dizzy.
